witness.label: Breviarium Romanum 1961, editio juxta typicam, Ordinarium Divini Officii, Ad Vesperas, §50, printed page 126
witness.inspection: Printed page image inspected manually; 10 complete Luc 1:46-55 verses transcribed as independent witness; typography and punctuation are not certified
witness.qualification: An edition reproducing the 1961 Ordinary; not evidence of the complete Advent I Proper or Saturday Psalter

canonicalization: ao-latin-v1 accent-insensitive lexical comparison including expanded ligatures and i/j; removes prayer punctuation, separators, pause marks and verse numbers; does not establish typographic, musical or punctuation identity
verifiedMeaning: Printed Magnificat and exact pinned Latin source agree lexically over ten verses under defined normalization; punctuation, chant notation, translations, and all other Hour components remain unverified
